Gym Creed – Charkop Branch

I am sharing my experience to help others make an informed decision before joining.

The air conditioning hardly works during the daytime. From 10 AM to 5 PM, the gym gets extremely hot and uncomfortable — it often feels like working out inside a furnace.

There is almost zero management. Only one or two staff members seem to pay attention; the rest appear uninterested in what’s happening in the gym. Member issues are not taken seriously.

The gym setup is slightly better compared to some other local gyms, but maintenance is a major problem.
If a machine breaks down, it takes 2–3 months to get repaired — this is from my personal experience.

Cleanliness is inconsistent. Some days the floors smell, and the washrooms are poorly maintained and often stink. This reflects a lack of regular cleaning standards.

5. Low Energy Environment
The overall energy of the gym feels dull and uninspiring. There is no motivating atmosphere for members.

Overall Verdict:
Gym Creed in Charkop has potential but suffers from poor management, lack of maintenance, hygiene issues, and low-quality environment. Not recommended unless major improvements are made.

I truly don’t have enough words to express my gratitude to my trainer, Aman Sir.
For the past 7 years, I have been suffering from severe leg and ankle pain, along with swelling. I had almost lost hope and believed that my weight was the main reason behind all my problems. Because of this, I could only wear soft, comfort footwear and had accepted it as my reality.
But everything changed after I started training with him.
He didn’t just train me—he transformed my mindset and lifestyle. Every single day, he pushed me beyond my limits, counting each rep with me and ensuring I gave my best. Yes, there was pain, especially in my legs, but it was the kind of pain that builds strength, not breaks you.
Along with strength and body shape, he has also significantly improved my flexibility, which has made a huge difference in my daily movements and overall comfort.
Today, I feel stronger, more flexible, more confident, and happier from within. For the first time in years, I can wear normal footwear—and that itself feels like a huge achievement for me.
He guided me not just with workouts but also with a proper diet plan and constant motivation. At times, his guidance felt like lectures—but now I realize their true value. Even though I’ve implemented only 5% of what he has taught me, I can already see a major transformation in my life. I can only imagine what I can achieve if I follow it 100%.
Thank you, Aman Sir. Calling you a “life changer” or “transformer” still feels like an understatement.
“Thank you” is truly a small word for what you’ve done for me.
Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious!
